calls.reason: The headline study finds favorable, company-centered framing, while TIME explains adoption and includes criticism. Neither establishes the alleged broad pattern across media coverage.
CNBC confirmed projected OpenAI losses of $5 billion for 2024. That supports the ordinary, colloquial financial point, although it does not establish ChatGPT-specific cash burn.
The Tow Center places heavy coverage after the initial adoption surge, and the tweet study documents early enthusiasm. Neither separates early media influence from user-driven adoption.
The news-portal experiment shows media influence on issue priorities, but not its dominance in driving demand for AI coverage. The UK headline study does not measure audience demand.
